description: Bounded binary32 normalized template matching and maximum-absolute-score selection from Rodinia Heartwall.

input.encoding: [image_rows, image_cols, template_rows, template_cols, candidate_mask, template_column_major, image_column_major]

output.encoding: column-major linear index of the first enabled candidate with maximum absolute normalized score

workspace.meaning: Bounded template/image, integral image and squared-integral image buffers, plus one staged output word.

contract.arithmetic: binary32 operations in the declared direct-accumulation order; upstream CUDA uses 2D prefix buffers for patch statistics, so intermediate rounding may differ
contract.correlation: Source rotates the template for convolution; the resulting valid-placement numerator is sum(T*P)-sum(P)*sum(T)/N. Dot products and direct window statistics accumulate column-major with row varying fastest.
contract.candidate_mask: One bit per valid top-left placement, column-major; disabled placements score zero.
contract.tie_rule: Scan candidates column-major and replace only on a strictly greater absolute score, retaining the first tie.
contract.zero_variance: Template variance and every enabled patch centered-square sum must be positive; otherwise malformed input returns -1.
contract.launcher_exclusions: Video/image I/O, initial template extraction, frame tracking, template adaptation, CUDA scheduling and host output are excluded.
